notes.title: [BETA] VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- v1.06.01 Experimental Branch
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

A new experimental beta patch for VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- has been released.

[b]The following issues have been resolved:[/b]
[list]
[*]An issue wherein the game would hang or loop on loading screens into missions and at various points throughout the game.[/list]

This latest patch, can be accessed through the Beta Branch options. Information as follows:
[b]Branch Name: beta[/b]
[b]Branch Password: vddebug2016111400[/b]

[h1]How to access [BETA] VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- v1.06.01[/h1]
[list]
[list]
[*]Open Steam Library
[*]Right Click VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI-
[*]Navigate to 'Properties'
[*]Select Tab 'BETA'
[*]Enter the password: vddebug2016111400
[*]Select 'Check Code'
[*]Once authorised select [b]'beta'[/b] 
[*]VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- will update to v1.06.01
[*]Note: Please try the fixes and let us know the results by emailing support@marvelousgames.com
[/list]

When emailing support please attach your LOG.TXT and DXDIAG.

Many Thanks

notes.title: VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- Experimental Branches
notes.content:
Hello all.

We have a variety of experimental branches available that may resolve issues you are having with the game. Please note that these fixes are still in test so are not 100% fixes. When they are confirmed as successful fixes they will be merged into the main default branch of the game.

There are three different branches for the issue wherein no sound is present when booting the game, so please try all three and confirm which one works, providing the log.txt would go a long way in helping with this issue and can be emailed to: support@marvelousgames.com, instructions are near the bottom of this post.

[b]v1.01.02[/b]
[list]
[*]Experimental fix for the issue wherein the game hangs on 'Checking DLC' screen
[/list]
[b]Accessing v1.01.02:[/b]
[list]
[*]Open Steam Library
[*]Right Click VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI-
[*]Navigate to 'Properties'
[*]Select Tab 'BETA'
[*]Enter the password: vddebug2016111400
[*]Select 'Check Code'
[*]Once authorised select 'beta' from the drop-down menu
[*]VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- will update to v1.01.02
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]v1.01.03[/b]
[list]
[*]Experimental fix for the issue wherein the game boots with no sound
[*]Note: Checking DLC bug fix is not active in these branches
[*]When reporting a fix, please let us know which beta_log_test build resolved the issue
[/list]
[b]Accessing v1.01.03[/b]
[list]
[*]Open Steam Library
[*]Right Click VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI-
[*]Navigate to 'Properties'
[*]Select Tab 'BETA'
[*]Enter the password: vddebug20170621
[*]Select 'Check Code'
[*]Once authorised select 'beta_log_test' OR 'beta_log_test2' OR 'beta_log_test3' from the drop-down menu, please try all fixes and let us know the results.
[*]VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- will update to v1.01.03
[/list]
[b]Testing the Fix[/b]
[list]
[*]Run VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- after selecting one of the branches above
[*]Play for a short while, confirm the fix
[*]Close the game with the X button on the top right side of the window
[*]Open the Log.txt file located in the following folder by default:
[*]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Valkyrie Drive\DeploymentRoot
[*]Check if the log file has been updated (the date should change)
[*]Send the log file to: support@marvelousgames.com
[/list]

Many Thanks for your support!
